arms.instruction: Improve the pinned solver using the complete visible development population and shared tools. Select and validate source-level algorithmic or implementation improvements autonomously. Preserve feasibility, objective semantics and truthful statuses.

inference_scope: Three fresh independent Agent starts per task and model on the same complete visible development view. No ABC intervention or extra hypothesis-registration requirement. Retain every outcome and report independent attempts separately, without selecting the best attempt for the primary comparison. Instance and solver-seed intervals describe each realized patch; Agent-generation variance is a separate dimension. No cross-version claim.
